traversal.toward_specialization: route_down, then children whose parent_module equals the current path.

traversal.overlays: The record spine_assignments where present; otherwise its route node and RTT evidence.

regimes.rule_source: Owner, 2026-11-19: modules with Operators and Nodes for RTT use are canon; all others are examples. All earlier 47 candidates plus Grammar, Principles and Lineage were confirmed canon.
regimes.method: Every one of the 698 attached JSON records was inspected. All are module manifests. Operator-definition fields were separated from operator scores, file references and analyzed subjects. Explicit node fields, RTT references, path parents and the available R5/R5.1 graph nodes were recorded.
regimes.canon: Owner-confirmed canon plus manifests that explicitly define both operators and nodes for RTT/canon use.
regimes.example: Non-canon material. It remains viewable with the Spine but is never presented as the Spine or canon.

spine.unplaced: Records whose parent family the metadata does not support are listed in module_register.json under node 'unplaced' and 'excluded'.

view.note: Everything remains viewable with the Spine. Only confirmed graph nodes are labelled Spine.

spine.definition: Records matched to the available R5/R5.1 A3 graph-node additions. Canon by construction.

organs.definition: Canon records outside the graph nodes visible in the supplied patches. They attach to the appropriate route node.

limbs.definition: Non-canon structural or RTT descendants: manifests that define operators/nodes for RTT use, or descend from canon. They remain attached but do not gain canon authority.

examples.definition: Records without structural operator/node attachment. Viewable through the examples region and register filters.

unplaced.definition: Empty or invalid manifests that cannot be classified until repaired.

view.graph_limit: The attached module_graph.json is identical to the R5 nodes_additions patch (30 nodes), not a full 196-node registry. With the R5.1 Clarity patch, 31 graph nodes can be confirmed from the supplied files.

semantic_audit.operator_evidence: module_register.json lists operator_fields and extracted operator identities for every record.
semantic_audit.node_evidence: module_register.json lists explicit node_fields, extracted node identities, graph_node and parent_module.
semantic_audit.authority_rule: Placement does not override regime. Spine and organs are canon; limbs and examples are not canon.
